label: Deterministic central differences for the Stage 1.3 shared physiology; research scenarios, not clinical targets.
change_rationale: Regenerated after independent Stage 1.2 reproduction and Stage 1.3 compliance redistribution, common-anatomy geometry, compensation-gain changes, and one-sided dependent-venous elastance. The new coefficient and all changed healthy mechanisms are also covered by the exported local analysis. Values are deterministic sensitivity scenarios, not independently fitted patient parameters.
assumptions: One parameter is perturbed at a time; interactions are explored separately in deterministic grids.
The hEDS lower-limb compliance increase is a modeling hypothesis, not a measured value.
Derivative magnitudes are local and operating-point dependent; blood-volume perturbations intentionally leave the calibrated supine operating point.
Hydrostatic-height derivatives are per cm; the central-difference step is 1/0.7356 cm, equivalent to 1 mmHg at 90 degrees.
The stiffening derivative uses a 0.000025 mmHg/mL^2 step and quantifies local response to an assumed constitutive form; it does not identify a tissue property.

heds_assumption.note: The hEDS 70 mL/mmHg value is an exploratory group-scenario assumption, not a measured coefficient; this comparison changes only compliance from the healthy computational background.
